canonical_industry_source: Must equal one of the canonical `industry` strings already governed in src/finengine/catalog.py's GROUPS industry scope_value and documented in docs/MASTER_SCHEMA.md, so a company's existing reviewed industry classification is what selects this pack -- no new classification taxonomy is introduced.
notes: sector_specific_fields is not_applicable for mining: catalog.py's 'mining' GROUPS entry only defines mining_operations KPI fields, with no distinct sector-specific statement template.

recoverable_reserves and mineral_resources follow the same JORC/SAMREC/SEC-style classification ambiguity flagged for oil_gas reserves -- extraction_mode for the mining field_group is requires_review at the master-contract level so a reviewer confirms which reserve classification basis a disclosed figure uses before it is published, since reserves and resources are not interchangeable and this project never silently treats one as the other.

all_in_sustaining_cost (AISC) is an industry-standard but non-IFRS metric with issuer-specific calculation footnotes; this pack requires the issuer's own stated AISC figure, never a recomputation from cash_cost_per_tonne plus an assumed sustaining-capex add-on.
